tickets.visual_thesis: An illustrative press posts a financing fair-value component to reported loss while separate cash does not change.
tickets.takeaway: Financing accounting changes affect reported loss; this does not mean cash was destroyed.

hero.kind: Original illustrative financing slip and accounting press
hero.action: Dario turns crank; slip feeds and reported-loss entry emerges
hero.end_state: Posted selected component beside unchanged illustrative cash

layers.foreground: Actor hands where contact requires it; captions in screen space

actor.contact: Dario hand and crank endpoint use one projected point
actor.occlusion: Hand holds foreground crank handle; paper passes behind front roller
actor.reason: Preserve current guide position while the world moves

motion.anticipation: Crank winds back before forward drive
motion.settle: Drive decelerates to its stop; host makes a small single impact response
motion.overlap: Slip feed leads record emergence; independent camera widens after posting

transition.reason: Calibration ends on component and cash distinction; no full-episode replacement
